core_obligations: Set H = F^{-1} circ G; the classification card gives the automorphism f and line bundle L with H^prime = f^* tensor L a sibling of H.
Siblings preserve being an equivalence and Coh behavior; the quasi-inverse of H^prime sends M to (f^{-1})^* M tensor L^{tensor -1}, displayed explicitly.
F = G circ H^{-1} is a sibling of G circ (H^prime)^{-1}, and the latter is FM by the composition card.
proof_roadmap: Build H, classify it, invert the displayed formula, and compose.
difficulty_reason: Reduction through the sibling calculus with an explicit inverse formula; omissions are auxiliary and formula-backed.
